ProcessOutputCaptureState.description: Per-stream capture facts, independent of the root process exit status. Complete capture requires `reachedEof` and neither limit flag. A closed producer without EOF can indicate read failure or forced reader shutdown.

stderr.description:
Buffered stderr capture.

Empty when stderr was streamed via `command/exec/outputDelta`.

stderrBase64.description: Exact undelivered stderr suffix; same contract as `stdoutBase64`.

stdout.description:
Buffered stdout capture.

Empty when stdout was streamed via `command/exec/outputDelta`.

stdoutBase64.description: Exact undelivered stdout suffix, appended after streamed raw deltas. When present use these bytes, not the lossy legacy `stdout` projection.

stdoutCapture.description: Absent only for peers/backends that cannot report capture facts.
